description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's internationalization (i18n) features, including encoding handling in formats like patch application, rebase, cherry-pick, and am commands. It sets environment variables, runs various Git commands, and verifies character encoding preservation across different languages and encodings.

methods.name: check_encoding
methods.description: Verifies that commit encodings are correctly preserved during various Git operations by checking the character encoding in commit headers and patches.
